programmes.d: Day 3 coverage of the 2026 FXR Bassmaster Elite Series on Lake Guntersville in Scottsboro, Alabama, as Semifinal Saturday brings rising pressure, tightened weights, and clutch performances in the fight to reach Championship Sunday.

As he celebrated his 52nd birthday, Hank Cherry turned back the clock at Lake Guntersville. The veteran angler from Lincolnton, N.C., used a traditional, old-school strategy to secure the FXR Bassmaster Elite title with 88 pounds, 11 ounces.

Day 4 coverage of the 2026 FXR Bassmaster Elite Series concludes on Lake Guntersville in Scottsboro, Alabama, as Championship Sunday delivers high stakes, bold decisions, and a final push for victory on one of bass fishing’s premier stages.
